scope: ACGN source and README design comparison
Implementable generic typed egraph and independently checkable explanations
required_design: Typed hash-consed enodes; sort-checked union-find; rebuild to congruence fixed point; generic typed pattern matching; registry-only rewrites; deterministic bounded saturation; positive-cost deterministic finite extraction.
Retain immutable ground-term proof DAG distinct from mutable class IDs; every union has rule or congruence proof provenance.

Independent checker recomputes exact rule instance endpoints, substitution sorts, directions and side conditions; congruence checks operator, arity, sort and ordered child proof endpoints; refl/symm/trans use exact endpoint equality.
Bind checked input/output and proof to typed profile, frozen registry and anonymous input digests. Check rejection produces no equivalence claim; it never changes solver result.
Child-only mapper accepts resolved AST and creates anonymous typed capability; engine never receives source, display strings, names or provenance hash as atom content.
Bound graph, match, round, union, extraction and proof budgets before mutation, including 2 MiB worker wire limit.
Keep exact structural canonical output separate; egraph representative equality is sufficient only within admitted checked rule profile, and bounded saturation is incomplete.
unsoundness_guards: Opaque binders and calls remain whole exact anonymous atoms unless context and substitution semantics are separately admitted.
Anonymous atom identity must preserve resolved refs and lexical context, not rendered spelling or user-provided identifiers.
Sort-specific relational empty; relation PLUS/MINUS differ from integer IPLUS/IMINUS; PLUSPLUS is override.
Exact nominal column-schema matching is conservative; Alloy unions across different signatures must become opaque or use validated common carrier.
Never use eclass membership itself as proof; checker must validate each edge locally.
Deterministic extraction must ignore hash iteration and UF representative numbering; positive cost avoids cyclic witnesses.
ACGN observations and certificate annotations do not establish Allow correctness; borrow design ideas without opaque binaries.
tests_required: Nontrivial congruence after multiple unions and rebuild; e-matching repeated variables; sort mismatch rejection.
Rule, substitution, direction, endpoint, congruence-child and trace-reference tampering rejected independently.
Cyclic eclasses extract finite valid witness deterministically; budget-limited runs preserve checked equivalence without completeness claims.
Alpha-renaming leaves full anonymous egraph output stable; binder shadowing, operand order, field-owner and schema negatives remain distinct.

contract_review.assessment: The revised contract resolves the initial typed-input, trace-language and claim-boundary blockers. Checked congruence is required even for canonicalized insertion collisions; unit tree cost and finite extraction are frozen. MixedFormula, substitution evaluation and MixedDerivation.someCong/noCong explicitly cover the previously missing relation-to-Boolean composition. Rule.notTrue/notFalse exist with semantic cases; 34 catalog mappings match the intended 8 Certificate, 13 Rule and 13 RelRule constructors. Twenty exact formal obligations and four closed named witnesses are listed.
contract_review.proof_gate: Root must complete the registered exact-proposition audit and two clean Lean builds before production changes. This review reads definitions and proofs; it does not claim independently executed clean builds.
implementation_gates: Every successful merge, including insertion/rebuild collisions, must be locally checked before mutation.
Independent checker validates exact ground endpoints, registered substitutions, ordered congruence premises and root/context/inventory/schema binding.
The mixed theorem uses one tuple carrier; multiple runtime schemas require conservative per-schema interpretation and tested adapter correspondence.
NONE may remain opaque; any later NONE-to-EMPTY lowering must preserve exact schema.
All budget failures preserve honest incomplete state and suppress unchecked equivalence output.

remaining_risks: No Java-to-Lean refinement is established; Java checker, catalog translation and Alloy lowering remain explicit trusted tested components.
Graph.justified is an assumed abstract invariant, not a verified Java union-find implementation.
No production implementation was reviewed or edited in this advisory.
Registered clean proof closure remains the root-owned prerequisite for implementation.
